title: scrnaseq-lite pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input. One row per sample. Technical replicates must be merged before they reach this pipeline.

sample.description: Sample identifier. Used as meta.id and therefore as the per-sample output directory name and file prefix throughout the pipeline.
sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.description: Gzipped FASTQ file for read 1, which carries the 10x cell barcode and UMI at fixed offsets. Nothing in this pipeline adapter-trims, quality-trims or length-filters it.
fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.description: Gzipped FASTQ file for read 2, the cDNA read. Required: droplet-based 10x libraries are always paired, so a single-end row cannot be quantified.
fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 must be provided, must exist, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

chemistry.description: 10x chemistry version. Single source of truth: this value is mapped to both the simpleaf chemistry and the QCatch chemistry by conf/modules.config, so the two cannot drift apart. It also fixes the expected read 1 length that SEQKIT_STATS asserts against: 26 bp for 10XV2, 28 bp for 10XV3 and 10XV4.
chemistry.errorMessage: Chemistry must be provided and be one of '10XV2', '10XV3' or '10XV4'

expected_cells.description: Optional. METADATA ONLY: it is never passed to simpleaf quant. simpleaf's permit-list modes (--expect-cells, --explicit-pl, --forced-cells, --knee, --unfiltered-pl) are mutually exclusive and this pipeline uses --unfiltered-pl, leaving cell calling to QCatch. This value is carried in meta for reporting and for sanity comparison against the number of cells QCatch actually calls.
expected_cells.errorMessage: expected_cells must be a positive integer, or left empty

errorMessage: Each sample name must be unique. Merge technical replicates of the same library before running this pipeline; it does not concatenate FASTQs.
